title: Query trace under coordinate permutations
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $\Omega$ be a set of coordinate values, and let $\alpha$ be a set of leaf labels. Let $A$ be a set of available coordinates among the $n$ coordinates, let $T$ be a finite decision tree over $\Omega$ with leaf labels in $\alpha$ and available coordinates $A$, and let $\sigma$ be a permutation of the $n$ coordinates. For every input $x$, the query trace of the coordinate-permuted tree is obtained by applying $\sigma$ to each coordinate in the query trace of $T$ on the input $i\mapsto x(\sigma(i))$.
